reviewer_concern: C3 calibration-source realism and 5% budget justification
scientific_question: How does the final mechanism respond to a predeclared range of sparse authenticated-reference budgets, without using the sweep to retune the frozen 5% default?
reason: one multiclass categorical and one numerical benchmark; both already have final calibration-quality evidence and provide complementary modalities

selector.family: hidden task-ID HMAC thresholding, same semantics as manuscript
selector.nested_masks: for each dataset/seed, compute one uniform selector value per immutable task ID; lower-rate masks are strict threshold subsets of the 10% mask

scoring.common_mask: score every rate on the identical complement of the 10% selector mask; tasks selected only by the 10% mask but not by a lower-rate mask remain ordinary for that lower rate but are excluded from metric scoring
scoring.reason: prevents a changing evaluation set from confounding the calibration-budget comparison

algorithm: LIR-PPTD canonical FC1 Full only; no parameter changes across budgets

statistics.contrasts: 1%, 2%, and 10% each paired against 5% within dataset; six planned contrasts total
statistics.test: exact two-sided sign-flip on selector-seed means
statistics.report: mean loss, 95% nested-bootstrap CI, delta vs 5%, realized calibration counts, sign-flip p/Holm p

deployment_case.reference_source: a calibrated fixed monitoring station or equivalently governed reference instrument covering the same spatiotemporal cell
deployment_case.authorization: after participant/report freeze, the reference authority signs task ID, configuration/participant binding, selector epoch/mode, and reference value; no worker sees the selector mode/reference before freeze
deployment_case.late_or_missing_reference: if no authenticated reference is available before the configured state-update timeout, no persistent transition is installed; the existing missing-calibration semantics apply
deployment_case.cost_model: if one authenticated reference costs C_ref, expected acquisition cost per task is pi*C_ref; this paper does not fabricate a measured C_ref
deployment_case.latency_model: reference-acquisition latency L_ref is external to MPC timing; it affects when a calibration transition can be installed, not the cryptographic ordinary-task timing; this paper does not fabricate a measured L_ref
deployment_case.selection_bias: selector depends only on immutable task ID and hidden seed, not report content, worker identity, or observed truth

decision_policy.LOW_BUDGET_STABLE: if 1-2% are close to 5%, state that useful evidence can persist below the frozen default; do not change default.
decision_policy.DEFAULT_JUSTIFIED: if 1-2% materially degrade while 5% is stable, describe 5% as the evaluated operating point rather than an optimum.
decision_policy.MORE_LABELS_HELP: if 10% is better, report that additional authenticated evidence helps; do not retune the manuscript default.
decision_policy.UNSTABLE: if performance is highly unstable across seeds/budgets, narrow deployment claims and retain calibration availability as a limitation; do not introduce new budget points.

forbidden_after_freeze: add a new dataset because results are weak
claim measured reference cost/latency without measurement
